items.title: Russia's fuel shortages ease as Ukraine faces Trump pressure to halt refinery strikes
items.teaser: Free fuel sales resumed in 15 Russian regions in October, Russian state-aligned newspaper Izvestia reported on Oct. 29.

items.title: Poland to transfer two more MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine
items.teaser: Poland will soon transfer two more MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine as part of a new military aid package worth around EUR 50 million. The package will also include ammunition and air defense equipment.

items.title: NATO announces new Ramstein meeting on Ukraine's defence
items.teaser: The United Kingdom and Germany will co-chair the next Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting at NATO headquarters in Brussels on 17 November 2026.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports record Russian losses of over 49,000 in October
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has highlighted a record surge in Russian troop casualties, surpassing previous figures from December 2024 amid rising daily losses.

items.title: Russian attacks cause new power outages in three Ukrainian oblasts
items.teaser: As of the morning of 29 October, Russian attacks had caused new power outages in Donetsk, Sumy and Kharkiv oblasts.

items.title: Ukraine finds Russia’s Geran drones fitted with a compass that works through GPS jamming, but Western electronics still at their core
items.teaser: Ukraine is also studying a new jamming device, and the findings go into its sanctions work.

items.title: Russische Drohne trifft Wohnhaus in Krementschuk – Zwei Tote
items.teaser: In Krementschuk in der Region Poltawa traf eine russische Drohne ein Mehrfamilienhaus, zwei Menschen kamen dabei ums Leben.

items.title: Ukraine needs EU support to develop decentralized power generation – Kachka
items.teaser: Ukraine needs support from the European Union to develop decentralized power generation, which would help ensure independent power supplies for residential buildings and keep businesses operating amid Russian attacks.

items.title: Germany news: Chancellor Friedrich Merz accuses North Korea of threatening Europe's freedom
items.teaser: Friedrich Merz, who is visiting Seoul, said North Korea is putting Europe's security at risk by sending soldiers to fight for Russia in Ukraine. DW has more.

items.title: Russia attacks poultry farm in Kyiv Oblast, killing a thousand birds
items.teaser: A Russian strike caused a fire at a Kyiv Oblast agricultural facility, killing a thousand birds before firefighters brought the blaze under control.

items.title: Russian drone has struck platform in Dnipro where commuter and passenger trains were standing – photos, video
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has posted photos and video of the Russian drone strike on a Dnipro railway platform that killed 13 people; six people are in a critical condition.

items.title: Russian attack on Dnipro railway station kills at least 13, injures 13
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked the railway station in Dnipro, killing at least 13 people. The number of those injured is not yet known.

items.title: No ceasefire violations in Oleshky, humanitarian aid delivery planned for Friday – Lubinets
items.teaser: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has announced that a humanitarian shipment is being prepared for residents of Oleshky.

items.title: 'Russia's mass murder:' Drone strike on Dnipro station kills 14 amid deadly daytime attacks on Chernihiv, Kremenchuk
items.teaser: Despite the air raid alert and announcements of a heightened threat, people remained on the platform, Ukrainian railways added.

items.title: Russen greifen Bahnhof in Dnipro an: Mindestens 13 Tote
items.teaser: Der Feind hat eine Verkehrsinfrastrukturanlage in Dnipro angegriffen: Es gibt Tote und Verletzte.

items.title: Russia may use the Oleshky truce to rebuild its forces, ISW warns, as evacuees face a route through Russia and Belarus
items.teaser: The agreement spells out every leg of the evacuees’ trip except the last one home.

items.title: Ukraine will drive European security even without near-term NATO membership – Chentsov
items.teaser: At this stage, Ukraine is thinking more in terms of partnership with NATO than membership, while seeking to join the EU as a factor in security on the continent.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 97 von 112 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 97 von 112 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 28. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Ankara tells Washington it’s ready to help revive Ukraine-Russia talks—but names no date or venue
items.teaser: Moscow claims a contact is near but that talk of Abu Dhabi is premature while it is still preparing. Kyiv wants that round before a summit without Ukraine.

items.title: Waffenruhe in Oleschky: Humanitäre Hilfe kommt am Freitag
items.teaser: Der Menschenrechtsbeauftragte der Werchowna Rada (Parlament – Anm. d. Red.), Dmytro Lubinez, teilte mit, dass eine humanitäre Hilfslieferung für die Einwohner von Oleschky zusammengestellt werde.

items.title: Ukrainian delegation heads toward Russian-occupied Oleshky – Arakhamia
items.teaser: A Ukrainian delegation led by Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets set off today toward the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region, where it will monitor the humanitarian operation.

items.title: Russia says 'battlefield situation' will determine when Ukraine peace talks begin
items.teaser: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov also ruled out European participation in the upcoming Abu Dhabi meeting.

items.title: Russian FPV drone strikes bus in central Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a bus approaching a bus stop in central Zaporizhzhia with an FPV drone, injuring four people.

items.title: Investing in conventional weapons better than developing nuclear program of one's own – expert
items.teaser: The best security guarantees are membership in the North Atlantic Alliance or, at the very least, protection under a "nuclear umbrella," while possessing nuclear weapons of one's own is too expensive and dangerous.

items.title: Cyberangriffe über Werbung treffen auch Smartphones
items.teaser: Manipulierte Anzeigen können Sicherheitslücken ausnutzen und Spionagesoftware einschleusen. Updates und Werbeblocker begrenzen das Risiko.

items.title: Drones target one of Russia’s largest chemical complexes in Bashkortostan, media report
items.teaser: On Thursday morning, October 29, drones attacked one of Russia’s largest chemical complexes in Bashkortostan, which manufactures products for the defense industry.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 189 Gefechte an der Front binnen eines Tages: 42 Angriffe des Feindes Richtung Pokrowsk abgewehrt
items.teaser: Am 28. Oktober kam es zu 189 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front. Der Feind übt besonderen Druck in Richtung Pokrowsk aus.

items.teaser: On 30 September 2026, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (PACE) adopted Resolution 2678 (2026) and Recommendation 2315 (2026) that seek to finally move ahead with the implementation of European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) judgments against Russia. items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1708: Russia clones Euromaidan Press to blame Ukraine for its own Kramatorsk strike
items.teaser: Ukraine pushes Operation Vivaldi across the Zherebets River.

items.title: Four injured in Russian drone attack on bus in Zaporizhzhia – video
items.teaser: Four people have been injured after Russian forces launched a drone attack on a bus in Zaporizhzhia, according to local military administration officials.

items.title: Defense forces repel 42 attacks in Pokrovsk sector as 189 clashes reported along front line in past 24 hours
items.teaser: Over the past 24 hours, on October 28, 189 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front lines, with the enemy exerting the most pressure in the Pokrovsk direction.

items.title: Teenager injured in Russian drone strike on Pavlohrad: shop and house catch fire
items.teaser: Oleksandr Hanzha reported that a 15-year-old girl suffered shrapnel wounds during a Russian strike that damaged residential and commercial property in Pavlohrad.

items.title: Russian forces launch nearly 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region since evening, injuring one person
items.teaser: Since this evening, Russian forces have launched nearly 20 drone attacks on Dnipro and the Dnipropetrovsk region; one man was injured.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,584,910 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,560 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Ukraine's human rights commissioner: Ceasefire in Oleshky has lasted 54 hours, humanitarian aid due Friday
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights, says mine clearance is progressing in Russian-occupied Oleshky, with humanitarian supplies due to arrive on 30 October and US journalists expected to document the mission.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf einen der größten Chemiekomplexe Russlands in Baschkortostan
items.teaser: Drohnen haben am Donnerstagabend dem 28. Oktober einen der größten Chemiekomplexe Russlands in Baschkortostan angegriffen.

items.title: Russia loses another 1,560 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
items.teaser: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to October 29, 2026—amount to approximately 1,584,910 personnel, including 1,560 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: What 'Putin's strikes' tell us about Russia’s war in Ukraine

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1560 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 29. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.584.910 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1560 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Polish defence ministry confirms transfer of two MiG-29 jets to Ukraine
items.teaser: Poland will deliver two MiG-29 fighter jets alongside ammunition to Ukraine as part of a new assistance package worth around €50 million.

items.title: Azov has struck more than 100 Russian trains in Donetsk region
items.teaser: Soldiers of the 1st Corps of the Ukrainian National Guard “Azov” struck more than 100 Russian trains carrying fuel and other supplies in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Battlefield sees 189 combat clashes, Ukrainian forces repel 42 Russian attacks on Pokrovsk front
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff reports 18 Russian attacks on the Kostiantynivka front and nine on the Huliaipole front as fighting continues across multiple fronts.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 112 drones: air defence downs 97, strikes recorded at seven locations
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched 112 drones overnight, including 40 jet-powered Shaheds, with strikes recorded at seven locations and debris falling at five others.

items.title: Russian forces strike educational institution in Kharkiv
items.teaser: The Russians launched drone strikes on the Kholodnogorsk and Saltiv districts of Kharkiv.

items.title: Eight people injured in Russian attacks on Sumy Oblast – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces struck 31 settlements in Sumy Oblast on 28 October, with drone attacks injuring civilians and damaging shops, cars, garages and houses.

items.title: Estonia to build 150 bunkers along Russian border
items.teaser: In response to an increase in Russian aggression in the region, the Baltic states have placed a strong emphasis on strategic readiness in recent years, encouraging civilian preparedness and ramping up defense spending.

items.title: Ukraine seeks to expand participation in special tribunal on Russian aggression, Karasevych says
items.teaser: Ukraine is working to expand the geographic representation of states in the special tribunal on Russia’s crime of aggression.

items.title: Russians conduct 849 attacks on Zaporizhzhia Oblast, damaging houses and infrastructure
items.teaser: Ivan Fedorov says Russian forces carried out hundreds of drone, aerial, artillery and multiple-launch rocket system attacks on 44 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast on 28 October.

items.title: Drones attack Sterlitamak, with smoke seen near chemical plant supplying Russia's defence industry – photos, videos
items.teaser: Monitoring Telegram channels report explosions and a drone attack in Sterlitamak, Bashkortostan, with smoke rising near the Bashkir Soda Company, a major chemical producer listed in Russia's defence industry register.

items.title: Drone attack targets Moscow, prompting airport restrictions
items.teaser: Drones attacked the Russian capital and the Moscow region. Two planes flying from Turkey to Moscow were diverted due to restrictions at Vnukovo Airport.

items.title: Russia restarts grain shipments through Sea of Azov, media reports
items.teaser: Kyiv's military campaign resulted in over 100 Russian vessels being hit in the Azov sea during the summer — negatively impacting Russia's economy and contributing to an increase in global grain prices.

items.title: Russia loses 1,560 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,560 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Military personnel can order NRK amphibious vehicles through Brave1 Market
items.teaser: A new class of ground-based robotic systems—amphibious ground-based robotic systems—is now available on the Brave1 Market platform for the military.

items.title: Germany and Japan reaffirm commitment to continued support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Germany and Japan have reaffirmed their commitment to continuing support for Ukraine and working closely together to achieve a just and lasting peace.

items.title: Russians strike educational facility in Kharkiv
items.teaser: Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov reports strikes in the Saltivskyi and Kholodnohirskyi districts, including a hit on an educational facility and a fire at another impact site.

items.title: UN to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians
items.teaser: The United Nations plans to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians from October 26, 2026, through March 2027, with about 84% of the aid earmarked for people living within 50 kilometers of the front line.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Pentagon watchdog rejects bipartisan plea to investigate Starlink disruption, AP reports
items.teaser: The refusal is interpreted by sources familiar with the matter as a way to avoid investigating Elon Musk and Starlink, AP reported.

items.title: Pentagon watchdog refuses to investigate Starlink restrictions for Ukraine – AP
items.teaser: The Pentagon’s inspector general has refused a bipartisan request to probe service disruptions to Starlink and Starshield used by Ukrainian forces.

items.title: Demining underway along civilian evacuation routes from Oleshky to Lubinets
items.teaser: Demining operations are currently underway along the routes used by civilians to leave the city of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

items.title: Putin's aide says trilateral talks will depend on the situation on battlefield
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov says the date and composition of the Russian delegation for planned trilateral technical talks will be decided later, with the meeting expected after 4 November.

items.title: Two State Emergency Service bomb disposal experts killed during demining operation in Sumy region
items.teaser: On October 28, in the Sumy region, two employees of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine were killed during a humanitarian demining operation.

items.title: A Russian disinformation campaign cloned Euromaidan Press to blame Ukraine for Russia’s own strike on Kramatorsk (we took the fake down)
items.teaser: Researchers tie the fake to Storm-1516, a Russian influence operation that has overtaken RT and Sputnik by cloning trusted news brands to publish fabricated stories under their names.

items.title: Canadian volunteer killed by Russian drone while rescuing animals in Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Jesse Adams, founder of the Canadian organization RainCoast Dog Rescue Society, was killed by a Russian FPV drone while evacuating animals from front-line Kramatorsk.

items.title: Russia holds captive journalists in inhumane conditions, subjects them to torture – Lubinets
items.teaser: Russian occupying forces are deliberately torturing Ukrainian journalists held in captivity and subjecting them to inhumane conditions.

items.title: Over 600 drones targeted Moscow and surrounding area
items.teaser: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin claims that 613 drones flew towards Moscow Oblast overnight, while restrictions were imposed at three airports and flights were diverted.

items.title: Aktualisierung der Anhänge der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung
items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.
